Title: Dreams In 3-D
Notes:
(2004 - 2006) (as Tyler, The Creator)
Dreams In 3-D is one of Tyler's earliest projects containing some of his earliest work, which contains 18 tracks in total. Every instrumental from this project was finished in early 2006. This project was planned to be recorded on, but ultimately never happened. This would later become the basis for At Your Own Risk.

Title:
At Your Own Risk [V1]
(Dreams In 3-D [V2])
Notes:
(2005 - 2007) (as Ace)
At Your Own Risk is another one of Tyler's earliest projects that was set to release on MySpace in 2008, containing a lot of reworked beats from Dreams In 3-D. This was mainly an instrumental album, with the only songs actually having vocals being Get Fresh, Speakerboxx & Sorry.... This project was likely shelved in favor of Stereo-Type sometime in early 2007, but was later worked on later that year. Tyler ended up making a final instrumental copy of this album in 2008 that he burned onto CD's and gave to friends. Although he is never known to have recorded on this copy, the instrumental copy is known to be had.

Title: At Your Own Risk
Notes: Album copy, burned onto CDs. One notable owner of this CD is Burtono, who was going to sell it to both Pac & Horse. Unfortunately, Pac ended up using the CD money to buy Flower Boy sessions, so Burtono ended up saying he lost these. This copy is, however, known to be had.

Title: CHROMAKOPIA
Notes:
(2020 - 2024) (2025) (as Tyler, The Creator)
CHROMAKOPIA is Tyler's eighth studio album, released on October 28th, 2024. This album is the first album by Tyler, The Creator to break many of his "traditions" when it comes to releasing albums: he broke his 2 year rule (a rule where he only drops an album every two years, The Estate Sale dropped just last year) & his 10th track rule (when there are two or three tracks in one track, specifically on the 10th track of the album). Work on the album began as far back as 2020 alongside CALL ME IF YOU GET LOST with the creation of “Mother.” Tyler has since shared that he once planned for CHROMAKOPIA to be his final album.

Title: DON'T TAP THE GLASS
Notes:
(2024 - 2025) (as Tyler, The Creator)
DON'T TAP THE GLASS is Tyler's ninth studio album, released on July 21st, 2025. This project started on December 31st, 2024 and all of the verses were recorded in May 2025 during the CHROMAKOPIA tour. It was first teased on July 16th with a photo of him with a trumpet in a marching band outfit, this is where fans got the idea that this was either for the Sticky music video that was teased months prior or a CHROMAKOPIA deluxe. On July 18th, the album's physicals were released on the Golf Wang store, which is how the fans got their first taste of the album.
